author: Grand Rapids MI Daily Brief
title: 🏥 Grand Rapids healthcare jobs: several flexible roles now hiring
text:
1 days ago Grand Rapids healthcare is busy and hiring—from hospitals to specialty clinics, there’s solid demand at every skill level right now. Here are several local roles that stand out this week.
RN Med Surg 4W (Part-Time, Days) Employer: Corewell Health – Butterworth Hospital Location: Grand Rapids, MI Type: Part time, 7:00am–7:30pm , 24 hrs/week , every other weekend Salary: Not listed Med-surg on a 32-bed acute unit with a wide variety of diagnoses—great place for new RNs to build skills . Self-scheduling, high-acuity patients, and a tight team plus full Corewell benefits (based on status). Inpatient Diabetes Educator Employer: Corewell Health Location: North Office Building, Grand Rapids, MI Type: Full time, days , Monday–Friday, 8:00am–5:00pm Salary: Not listed RN or RD role focused on patient diabetes education, counseling, and program development . Requires Bachelor’s , 3+ years’ recent clinical experience, and CDE within 3 years ; daytime hours and system-level impact. Genetic Counselor – Medical Genetics Employer: Corewell Health Location: 25 Michigan St NE, Grand Rapids, MI Type: Full time, days , Monday–Friday, 8:00am–5:00pm Salary: Not listed Join a large genetics team (6 physicians, 13 GCs) seeing peds and adult patients, with in-person and virtual visits and multidisciplinary clinics. Master’s in genetic counseling and MI license required; ABGC board cert within 1 year. Sterile Processing Tech – Up to $5,000 Sign-On Bonus Employer: Corewell Health – Butterworth Hospital Location: Grand Rapids, MI Type: Full time, days , Monday–Friday, 7:00am–3:30pm, every third weekend Salary: Not listed; up to $5,000 sign-on bonus Fast-paced OR support role cleaning, assembling, and sterilizing instruments. Includes a 90-day orientation + SPD training course ; high school diploma required and certification within 18 months. Pharmacy Technician (Closed-Door Pharmacy) Employer: PharMerica Location: Grand Rapids, MI Type: Full time Salary: Not listed Non-retail, long-term care pharmacy setting with room for growth and a full benefits package. Duties include filling and packaging meds, compounding, inventory, and potential work with IVs and automated machines ; state Pharmacy Tech license required . Surgical Technologist – Up to $10,000 Sign-On Bonus Employer: Trinity Health Location: Grand Rapids & Muskegon, MI Type: Full time, variable days/evenings/nights Salary: Not listed; up to $10,000 sign-on bonus , DailyPay, day-1 benefits Work in the OR assisting surgeons with instruments, supplies, and maintaining strict aseptic technique. Requires accredited Surg Tech program completion and certification within 1 year. Patient Access – Medical Office Associate Employer: The Cancer & Hematology Centers Location: Grand Rapids, MI Type: Full time Salary: Not listed Front-end role at a community oncology practice , handling referrals, new-patient scheduling, records, and phones. Good fit if you’re organized, patient-focused, and want to support people through cancer care. Nurse Tech (Nights) Employer: Corewell Health – Blodgett Hospital Location: East Grand Rapids, MI Type: Full time, nights , 36 hrs/week Salary: Not listed Entry-level bedside role on acute units at a 330-bed teaching hospital . You’ll take vitals, check blood sugars, assist with bathing, ambulation, wound care, and more under RN supervision; high school diploma required. RN or LPN – Long Term Care (Up to $10,000 Sign-On) Employer: Corewell Health – Rehab & Nursing Center – Cedar Location: 1226 Cedar St NE, Grand Rapids, MI Type: Full time, 7:00pm–7:30am , every third weekend Salary: Not listed; up to $10,000 sign-on bonus Overnight role in a brand-new long-term care center with modern private rooms and shared courtyards. Open to RNs and LPNs who want deeper relationships with residents in a home-like setting. Medical Assistant (CMA or RMA) – Float/Staffing Employer: Interim HealthCare Location: Grand Rapids, MI Type: Full time Salary: $22–$23/hour , same/next-day pay available Staffing MA role with varied clinic settings , weekly pay, and ESOP retirement benefit. You’ll room patients, take vitals, draw blood, give injections, and help with front-office tasks; requires accredited MA program and 1 year recent MA experience. Medical Assistant (MA) – Pelvic Medicine Employer: Trinity Health MI Location: Grand Rapids, MI Type: Full time, day shift Salary: Not listed; day-1 benefits , DailyPay Clinic-based MA role supporting pelvic medicine visits—rooming, vitals, EKGs, injections, point-of-care tests, and admin work. Requires HS diploma and MA/EMT/Paramedic training or 2+ years clinic experience.
